about_the_game:
Experience Prologue Version

Mini Racer Car Shop Simulator Prologue is your introduction to the world of mini car shop management! This Prologue version provides a taste of the full game, offering a similar experience with select content limitations. Manage your shop, customize mini cars, and take them to the race track for unique challenges. Get a feel for the exciting gameplay before diving into the full Mini Racer Car Shop Simulator!

Experience special Prologue challenges across three unique chapters, each designed to introduce you in managing your shop, customizing mini cars, and racing them on the track!

Find Rare Spare Parts

Each car pack features a gacha system that adds an extra layer of excitement! Try your luck and draw for rare spare parts that could be the key to building your ultimate mini racer. Every draw offers a random part, making each pull a thrilling opportunity to enhance your collection.


Sell Mini Cars

Access a selection of highly detailed miniature racing car models designed to attract car enthusiasts. Carefully manage your stock to always have the best selection available, keeping your customers satisfied. As the shop owner, you can also start your personal mini car collection by opening car packs!

Sell Spare Parts

In addition to selling mini cars, provide a variety of spare parts to enhance their performance. From mini engines to wheels and unique components, offer your customers the best selection for building their dream cars. Each part has different quality levels and performance attributes, making inventory management a crucial strategy.

Custom Car Showcase

Show off your most impressive custom-built mini cars in a dedicated showcase area! Here, you can display your masterpieces for customers to admire and purchase. Set your own price based on the car’s performance and rarity.

Test Drive Your Car

Take your custom-built mini cars for a test drive on a race track! Experience their speed, handling, and unique upgrades firsthand. Special race challenges are available in the Prologue version, allowing you to push your creations to the limit and refine your builds for optimal performance.


Mini Racer Car Shop Simulator Prologue offers an exciting preview of the full game, making it the perfect starting point for you. Begin your journey today and turn your shop into the ultimate destination for customers!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64bit or newer
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 1600 / Intel Core i5-8400
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVidia GeForce GTX 970 4GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64bit or newer
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 3600 / Intel Core i7 7700K
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVidia GeForce GTX 1070 8GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
